record.one_liner: SEO and SERP data API (SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page and content analysis) for developers and AI agents.
record.auth_notes: Login plus a generated API password, sent as HTTP Basic auth. The API password is issued in the dashboard and is not the account password. OAuth 2.0 is used only by the hosted MCP server, not the REST API.
record.access_notes: A free account gives access to the API Access tab for credentials. Live calls are billed against account balance, and the Sandbox is the only free route with dummy data.
record.api_notes: REST API at api.dataforseo.com/v3 with many API families; breadth judged from the docs index, not counted endpoint by endpoint.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials are self-serve, but live data use spends prepaid balance; this is not a paid-plan gate on the API itself.
